assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
The attached complete transparent plant PNG is the EDIT TARGET. Create the same plant in a MUCH MORE ABSTRACT, BEAUTIFUL FANTASY OIL-PAINTING style.

Use brush marks approximately THREE TIMES BROADER than in the reference: broad sweeping impasto petals, thick soft buttery paint, generous palette-knife planes and expressive broken edges. Simplify each leaf to a few large green/olive color planes; REMOVE visible leaf veins, hairline texture, botanical engraving, photorealistic surface detail and glossy CGI rendering. Shape and light should read as bold painted masses, with deliberate expressive abstraction throughout both flower and leaves. Keep it graceful and luminous, never muddy.
Preserve exactly this design's recognizable whole-plant silhouette, head count, natural pose/orientation, flower family, petal COLOR FAMILY and lighting direction/temperature. Keep stems and foliage in their original natural green/brown family. Flowers are clearly readable and main heads stay attached to the same stems/leaves; no detached petals or floating fragments. Do not introduce a different flower design or extra branches.
ONE WHOLE INDEPENDENT PLANT on a genuine transparent alpha background. Entire head(s), all leaf tips and cleanly finished stem bottom inside canvas, leave approximately TWELVE PERCENT EMPTY TRANSPARENT PADDING on every side, shrink plant within canvas if needed. Square canvas, native size at least 1024 pixels. No soil, ground plane, pot, cast floor shadow, backdrop, painted checkerboard, text, label, number, border or watermark. No sprite sheet and no multiple views. This is BG01-F01-C01-V05; output art contains no text.
